item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Meets Papers, Please in Steam’s Latest Surprise Viral Hit
item.description: Every now and then, a game with little to no fanfare pre-launch gets blessed by the algorithm and surges in popularity. Probably Stolen is the latest recipient of this; after being released on Oct. 28, it's continued to climb in popularity, peaking at 174,382 concurrent players on Nov. 4, according to SteamDB .

item.title: Fortune treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: All Gold Skulltula locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Gold Skulltulas act as a collectible in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but they're also needed to cure a cursed family in Kakariko Village.

item.title: 5 Incredible Anime Arcs That Are 10/10, No Notes
item.description: Consider the Chimera Ant arc from Hunter x Hunter , which is nothing short of a rite of passage . It pushes the anime’s deconstruction of shonen conventions to its limits while sending Gon Freecss and Killua Zoldyck down starkly different paths. The Shibuya Incident arc from Jujutsu Kaisen is similarly transformative, shattering the established order of jujutsu society through its intersecting perspectives, major character deaths, and relentless succession of battles.

item.title: Commander Shepard’s Actor Accidentally Immortalized One Mass Effect Race as Steve Buscemi
item.description: Polygon spoke to Mass Effect's Mark Meer about how he joined the series and how he and fellow Shepard Jennifer Hale defined the character.

item.title: The No. 1 Horror Movie of 2026 Is Officially Leaving Peacock
item.description: Not many directors can say their debut film was a blockbuster hit, let alone a cultural phenomenon. But newcomer Curry Barker, who wrote and directed Obsession , the No. 1 horror movie of 2026 , can say he's accomplished both. The film takes a look at the dangers of getting exactly what you wish for when Bear (Michael Johnston) makes a wish that his friend Nikki Freeman (Inde Navarrette) would love him more than anyone else in the world. Despite being made on only a $750,000 budget, the film dominated the box office when it hit theaters, earning $17.2 million in its first week and a staggering $23.9 million in its second week.

item.title: Dropout’s Vic Michaelis Wants to Toss Their Star Wars Character Out a Window
item.description: Dropout star Vic Michaelis used to fall asleep to Attack of the Clones . Not because they hated it, like so many Star Wars prequel detractors, but because it was their comfort watch. “I've seen the first 45 minutes of Episode II , I want to say, 300 times,” Michaelis told Polygon. “It's so comforting. The prequels hold a place in my heart where it is like nothing bad can happen when I'm watching them.”

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Physical Copies Are Officially in the Wild
item.description: With preloads for Grand Theft Auto 6 just around the corner, Rockstar Games has sent the code-in-box editions to retailers, so stores can deliver them to customers on time. Shipments have started to arrive, giving us a first look at the physical edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 .
